mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(team_member_teacher.teacher) AS teamNumbers, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(user_info.`name`) FROM user_info INNER JOIN team_member_teacher ON user_info.id = team_member_teacher.teacher WHERE team_member_teacher.team = team_info.id AND team_member_teacher.is_deleted = 0) AS teacherNames FROM team_info LEFT JOIN team_member_teacher ON team_info.id = team_member_teacher.team WHERE team_info.id = #{id} AND team_member_teacher.is_deleted = 0
